name: superset-jalali
description: Jalali (Persian) calendar for the Superset frontend: time formatters, Jalali time-range shortcuts and a Jalali date picker.
comment: Not installed into superset-frontend: superset/Dockerfile copies src/ into superset-frontend/src/jalali/ and the patches hook it in, so Superset's own package-lock.json stays untouched and `npm ci` keeps working. These devDependencies only exist to type-check and test this directory on its own.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:components
